title: Bridge Round Decision
description: Series A fell through. Do you take a bridge at punishing terms, cut costs aggressively, or pursue a strategic acqui-hire?

decision.prompt: Your lead investor passed on Series A. Choose your path.

options.label: Take bridge at 20% discount
options.description: Accept dilutive bridge terms to buy 6–9 more months. Bet on hitting new milestones to re-raise.

options.label: Cut 40% of team
options.description: Aggressive right-sizing to extend runway without outside capital. Painful but preserves equity.

options.label: Pursue strategic acquisition
options.description: Engage strategic buyers for an acqui-hire or full acquisition. Likely below your last valuation.

months_runway.label: Months of Runway Remaining
months_runway.description: How many months of cash remain at current burn.

arr.label: Annual Recurring Revenue ($)
arr.description: Current ARR at time of decision.

investor_relations.label: Investor Relationship Quality
investor_relations.description: Current state of your relationship with existing investors.
